title: Filtrations and cohomology on graph products
summary: Let $p$ be a prime. We resolve a question posed by Mináč-Rogelstad-Tân. We relate the Zassenhaus and the lower central series of pro-$p$ groups under a torsion-freeness condition. We also study graph products of (pro-$p$) groups under natural assumptions. In particular, we compute their graded Lie algebras associated with the previous filtrations, as well as their cohomology over $\mathbb{F}_p$.
